feeds.title: Hello Hong Kong Blog
feeds.description: See the latest updates from Hong Kong including our day tours, cool activities, and Hong Kong life in general. Hello Hong Kong specializes in organizing private tours and group tours of Hong Kong. We focus on introducing you to hidden gems, exploring the back streets, and learning about local businesses as well as explaining Hong Kong's culture, customs, and history.

feeds.title: Hong Kong Tourism Board
feeds.description: From intangible culture to world-class theme parks. From mouth-watering street food, to breathtaking natural vistas and beyond, Hong Kong has it all!
